text:
Maya R: hey team, I need to swap my primary for tonight — unexpected doc appt, ETA ~22:30 PST. Can someone cover 22:00-06:00 PST? I can shadow first 30m then hand off fully. :wave:
Jonas K: I can take the primary from 22:00-02:00, then Alex can pick up 02:00-06:00?
Alex P: yup I can take 02-06. Quick Q — is there any scheduled maintenance tonight that might affect routing?
Maya R: nothing in the calendar AFAIK; I double-checked infra-calendar. No deploys to prod after 18:00.
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager assigned: #oncall-primary -> Maya R (now escalated to Jonas K) — alert summary: elevated token errors on embeddings ingestion (error rate spike 14:36 UTC). See incident page: https://incident.redwood/INC-2026-214
Maya R: thanks bot — that's from earlier today, SRE mitigated a target pool restart. Postmortem says transient. I'm still okay to hand off tonight, just wanted coverage for personal reasons.
Jonas K: got it. I'll take primary at 22:00. Can someone paste the handoff checklist? want to make sure I don't miss stale KV cache warmups.
Alex P: runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall-handoff — key items:
- confirm primary/secondary in pagerduty
- check per-route latency dashboards (Console -> Routes -> Production)
- warm cache: `curl -XPOST https://cache.redwood/internal/warm?model=gpt-4o-mini`
- confirm KV cache size and TTLs in /infra/kv-stats
- set temporary routing override if high-error rates reappear
Maya R: also add: check `dedicated-pool-3` GPU health, we saw a flakey host earlier. run `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=dedicated-pool-3`
Jonas K: copying the checklist into my notes.
Alex P: quick wrap on rotation: Jonas -> Alex handoff at 02:00. We'll do a short ping 10m before oncall-bot to confirm.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled rotation command queued — at 01:50 UTC will send 02:00 handoff ping to @Jonas K and @Alex P
Jonas K: ping me at 01:50 UTC please. I'll also run a quick traffic test at 01:55 to verify model fallbacks.
Maya R: thanks both. Jonas — FYI customer-impact list (if anything pops):
- Customers A/B/C on embeddings ingest — route `embed-ingest-us`
- Critical partners: partner-analytics (low tolerance for delay)
- SLOs: 95% tokens < 200ms per-token latency for embed-ingest during peak
Jonas K: noted. I'll watch that route and the embeddings error counters. Where are the alert thresholds?
Alex P: thresholds: Pager -> EmbedsErrorRate >= 5% for 5m or 3% for 15m triggers primary. See https://console.redwood/alerts/embed-errors
Jonas K: thanks. If I see >5% I'll escalate immediately and flip to the canary model (fallback flow) — is the canary route `embed-ingest-canary` ready?
Maya R: yes, it's healthy. flip process is in runbook: `POST /api/route/override {route: "embed-ingest-us", target: "embed-ingest-canary"}` — must be done from bastion with MFA.
Jonas K: good. One more: what's the secondary's role during lots of traffic? do we want active-active or passive?
Maya R: for tonight keep secondary passive unless primary has degraded. We don't want duplicate billing. Only flip route on degradation or explicit failover.
Alex P: understood. I'll be available on slack and phone if needed. Phone for me is +1-555-0202.
Jonas K: added contact. I'll kick off a pre-handoff checklist at 21:50 PST and post a quick verification message here once primary toggled in PD.
Maya R: sounds great. If anything spikes, tag me @Maya R and I'll try to jump in remotely. thanks for covering. :heart:
Alex P: pinging PD now to add Jonas as temp primary for 22:00-02:00, and Alex as temp secondary 02:00-06:00.
Incident Bot: PD update: Jonas K added to role `oncall-primary` (effective 22:00 PST -> 02:00 PST), Alex P added to `oncall-secondary` (effective 22:00 PST). Confirmation ID: PD-4720
Jonas K: got the PD confirmation. I'll set a watch on the latency and embed error panels and enable detailed traces for `embed-ingest-us` for the window.
Alex P: FYI I'll run a dry-run of the fallback at 01:40 — no traffic flip, just simulate fallbacks on a staging token. Will report in thread.
Maya R: appreciate it. One nit: remember to set the release-guard flag if you do any route overrides: `release-guard: true` in the override payload so the Console knows it's manual.
Jonas K: noted.
(22:05 PST) Jonas K: post-handoff quick check: PD shows me as primary, metrics look normal, no new alerts. Warmed KV caches for top 10 prefixes, ran `curl` warmers.
Alex P: 01:42 UTC dry-run complete — fallback simulation succeeded, no unintended route flips.
Jonas K: 01:55 UTC traffic test: small ramp to 20 RPS for embed-ingest-us, no errors observed.
Alex P: prepping to take primary at 02:00. I'll wait for 01:50 ping.
oncall-bot: Reminder: 01:50 UTC handoff ping incoming in 10 minutes for rotation (Jonas K -> Alex P).
Jonas K: 01:50 UTC — handing over in 10. switching monitoring to Alex in PD now.
Alex P: took over primary at 02:00 — quick verification: PD shows Alex P primary, traces flowing, KV warmness still good. I'll keep an eye until 06:00.
Maya R: thanks both. leaving a short post-handoff note: no customer-impact observed during window, all green. I'll update my calendar leave to indicate swap done.
Jonas K: thanks — great teamwork.
Alex P: closing the thread once we've got final checks at 05:50.
(05:52 PST) Alex P: final check — metrics still OK, no escalation, ending coverage early handback to Maya on calendar at 06:00.
Maya R: confirmed back. Thanks again.
